author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices finding G by the three black keys, high and low G, echoing short tunes, and playing together, with a cheerful counting song.

classes.title: Knick-knack on my knees
classes.goal: Hear the whole song, pat the beat on your knees and tap thumbs on 'knick-knack'.

mathTarget.parentLine: Feeling a beat that comes again and again, evenly spaced

classes.parentPrompt: Pat your knees to the beat together; tap thumbs together on 'knick-knack'.
classes.childAction: Pat your knees, and tap thumbs on 'knick-knack'.
classes.bridge: The beat is the old man's drum: pat, pat, pat, all the way home.

intro.caption: Let's play knick-knack
intro.parentCue: pat your knees together to the beat.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: feeling the steady beat with your body.

classes.title: Paddywhack steady beat
classes.goal: Tap one steady tap on each beat while the grown-up plays the tune.

mathTarget.parentLine: One tap for each beat, no more, no less

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand on your child's hand; tap together, then slowly let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key once for every beat you hear.
classes.bridge: Each beat is one knick-knack tap; one tap for every beat.

intro.caption: One beat, one tap
intro.parentCue: tap your child's shoulder on each beat.

games.caption: This old man, he played one

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one tap for each beat.

classes.title: G, by the three black keys
classes.goal: Find G using the group of three black keys.

mathTarget.parentLine: Three black keys help us find G every time

classes.parentPrompt: Touch the three black keys together; show that G hides between the first two.
classes.childAction: Find three black keys, then play G between the first two.
classes.bridge: G sits snug between the first two of the three black keys.

intro.caption: Let's find the three black keys
intro.parentCue: touch them together, one, two, three.

games.caption: One, two, three: G, G, G

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding G by the three black keys.

classes.title: G down low, G up high
classes.goal: Find G in a second place on the piano, higher up.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same note lives again higher up, in another house

classes.parentPrompt: Point to the low G, then the high G; hop your child's hand between them.
classes.childAction: Hop between the two G's: low house, then high house.
classes.bridge: Every G sits in the same spot by each group of three black keys.

intro.caption: G has two houses
intro.parentCue: point to the low G, then the high G.

games.caption: Hop: G, then high G
games.parentCue: Guide the hop gently, then let go

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding the same note in two places.

classes.title: This old man: G, E, G
classes.goal: Copy short patterns from the song: high, low, high again.

mathTarget.parentLine: Hearing a high note, a lower note, then high again

classes.parentPrompt: Sing 'this old man' with your hand high, low, high, then point: your turn.
classes.childAction: Echo G, E, G: high, low, high again.
classes.bridge: G, E, G is a little see-saw: up, down, up.

intro.caption: I play, then you echo
intro.parentCue: move your hand high, low, high as it plays.

games.caption: This old man: G, E, G
games.parentCue: Play it first, then point: your turn

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening and playing short tunes back.

classes.title: Give the dog a bone
classes.goal: Echo short patterns, then climb the stairs from C up to G.

mathTarget.parentLine: Each note is the next stair up, in order

classes.parentPrompt: Point to each key in order; let your child walk one finger up behind you.
classes.childAction: Echo the stairs: walk one finger up, key by key.
classes.bridge: Give the dog a bone climbs the white stairs, C up to G.

intro.caption: Let's climb the stairs
intro.parentCue: point to each key, one after another.

games.caption: Give the dog a bone
games.parentCue: Walk one finger up, key by key

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing notes in order, step by step.

classes.title: Wait for the G
classes.goal: Listen to the song and play G at the right moments.

mathTarget.parentLine: Waiting for your part is part of the music

classes.parentPrompt: Play the blue keys; nod to your child just before each G.
classes.childAction: Wait and listen, then play G when it's your turn.
classes.bridge: The old man plays the tune; G is your knick-knack tap.

intro.caption: Listen for your G
intro.parentCue: nod to your child just before each G.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: waiting for your turn, then playing.

classes.title: G and E, high and low
classes.goal: Play two special notes, G and E, when they light up in the song.

mathTarget.parentLine: Hearing and seeing which of two notes comes next

classes.parentPrompt: Point to G or E just before it lights, then let your child play it.
classes.childAction: Play G or E when its key lights up in the song.
classes.bridge: G is the high seat, E the low seat, like a see-saw.

intro.caption: Now we have two keys
intro.parentCue: point to G, then E, before the song starts.

games.caption: G, E, G, two times
games.parentCue: Point to each key before it lights

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: telling G and E apart in a song.

classes.title: Rolling home together
classes.goal: Play the whole song together, the grown-up on the tune, the child on G and E.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two players keep the same beat, so the song stays together

classes.parentPrompt: Keep playing even if a note is missed; nod the beat with your head.
classes.childAction: Play your G and E while your grown-up plays the rest.
classes.bridge: You and your grown-up roll home side by side, beat by beat.

intro.caption: Let's play it together
intro.parentCue: keep going, even if a note is missed.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping one beat with two players.

classes.title: Old man's concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy from start to end, then bow together.

mathTarget.parentLine: The tune wanders up and down, then rolls home to C

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; play the whole song, then clap and bow together.
classes.childAction: Play your G and E to the very end, then take a bow.
classes.bridge: The old man taps, gives the dog a bone, and rolls home to C.

intro.caption: Concert time for teddy!
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, start to end.
